card.name: Publisher digit in book ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit right after the start of an ISBN, usually after 978-0- or 0-, in book citations and reference lists. It marks the publisher-code digit.

modes.label: ISBN publisher digit
modes.description: The first digit of the publisher group after the 978-0- or 0- start of an ISBN.
modes.example: Cambridge: Cambridge University Press. pp. 406–451. ISBN 978-0-<<5>>21-23541

modes.label: Color code digit
modes.description: A digit inside a hex color code in forum markup, which is a rare case.
